map.Fagerström 尼古丁依赖检验量表(6题)，评估烟草依赖程度并指导戒烟药物: Fagerstrom Test for Nicotine Dependence (6 items) assessing tobacco dependence and guiding cessation medication and behavioral intervention
map.📖 查看「尼古丁依赖自评器(FTND) 使用指南」: 📖 View the Nicotine Dependence Self-Rating Tool (FTND) user guide
map.FTND 尼古丁依赖量表总分 = 6 个问题之和（0–10）；不超过3 轻度依赖: FTND total = sum of 6 questions (0-10); <=3 mild dependence, <=6 moderate, >6 severe; this selects treatment intensity: behavioral intervention / nicotine replacement / varenicline etc.
map.1. 你早晨醒来后多久吸第一支烟？: 1. How soon after waking do you smoke your first cigarette?
map.2. 在禁烟场所是否难以控制？: 2. Do you find it hard to refrain in no-smoking places?
map.3. 哪支烟最不愿放弃？: 3. Which cigarette would you hate most to give up?
map.早晨第一支: The first one in the morning
map.5. 早晨是否比其他时间吸烟多？: 5. Do you smoke more in the morning than at other times?
map.6. 即使生病卧床仍吸烟？: 6. Do you still smoke when ill and confined to bed?
map.行为干预为主，可短程NRT: Mainly behavioral intervention; short-course NRT acceptable
map.联合药物(伐尼克兰+NRT)，长期随访: Combined medication (varenicline + NRT) with long-term follow-up
map.提示：FTND≥4分提示中重度依赖，药物治疗获益明显。一线药物包括尼古丁替代(N: Note: FTND >=4 suggests moderate-to-severe dependence where medication clearly helps. First-line drugs include nicotine replacement (NRT patch / gum), varenicline and bupropion. Quitting markedly lowers the risk of COPD, lung cancer and cardiovascular disease. The 5 A's (Ask-Advise-Assess-Assist-Arrange) structure cessation intervention. Clinical reference only.
map.6 题各取分值求和；如 4+1+0+0+0+0=5 分→中度依赖。: Sum the 6 item scores; e.g. 4+1+0+0+0+0 = 5 -> moderate dependence.
map.≤3 分低依赖，可先行为干预+简短随访。: <=3 is low dependence; start with behavioral intervention plus brief follow-up.
map.同为 FTND，本工具为简化自评版，用于快速分层。: Both are FTND; this tool is the simplified self-rating version for quick stratification.
map.戒烟后 2 周、1 月复评依赖与戒断症状。: Reassess dependence and withdrawal at 2 weeks and 1 month after quitting.
map.关于「戒烟(尼古丁依赖)自评器」: About the Smoking Cessation (Nicotine Dependence) Self-Rating Tool
map.戒烟(尼古丁依赖)自评器，采用Fagerström尼古丁依赖检验量表(FTND): Smoking Cessation (Nicotine Dependence) Self-Rating Tool uses the Fagerstrom Test for Nicotine Dependence (FTND) to assess tobacco dependence and guide cessation drug choice. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
